title: Search conversation history
description: Search existing conversations on chatgpt.com via the search modal UI or observed backend API without sending a new chat prompt.

inputs.query: Keyword to search in conversation history.
inputs.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

api: Run `node .agents/skills/chatgpt-project/references/api-client.mjs search-history --query "<keyword>" [--limit 10]` or import `searchHistory({ query, limit })` from `api-client.mjs`.
Underlying endpoint: `POST /backend-api/global/search` with JSON body `{ entrypoint, limit, query, source_requests, cursor, query_id }` and shared auth headers (`parameterGroup` in `api.json`).

Loads local cookies and `Authorization: Bearer ...` from the newest local capture under `artifacts/chatgpt.com/`. If auth is expired (`401`/`403`) or Cloudflare challenge appears, switch to `chatgpt:auth` or `chatgpt:browser-search-history`.
browser: Inspect the sidebar on `https://chatgpt.com/` and locate the search history control (do not click new chat).
Click the search control, inspect the dialog for `[role="dialog"] input[role="combobox"]`, and call `studio_fill` with `parameter: "query"`.
Wait for `[role="dialog"] [role="listbox"]` and extract matching conversation titles/links with `studio_extract`.
success: Returns matching conversation titles and URLs (or explicit empty-result state) without submitting a new chat message.
verification: Recorded UI workflow and `POST /backend-api/global/search` contract; re-verify live token before standalone API calls.

execution.evidence: Recorded browser workflow and associated backend search request; reusable helper provided in api-client.mjs.
